mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_team (name, owner_id, avatar, description, status, quota, used_space) VALUES (#{name}, #{ownerId}, #{avatar}, #{description}, #{status}, #{quota}, #{usedSpace})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_team ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT t.* FROM t_team t INNER JOIN t_team_member m ON m.team_id = t.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 AND t.status = 1 ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_team SET name = #{name}, avatar = #{avatar}, description = #{description}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_team SET status = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_team SET quota = #{quota}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_team SET used_space = GREATEST(used_space + #{delta}, 0), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_team WHERE name = #{name} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
